messages:
maya: Hey team — I need temporary SecretsManager 🔐 read access to pull the DEK for the encryption-job that's failing in staging. One-off debug, ~30m. Can someone grant break-glass / JIT? @raj @security
oncall-bot: Incident detected: ticket INC-4821 created for the job failures. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821
raj: What's the exact ARN and scope? We prefer least-privilege. Also need justification and requested end time.
maya: ARN: arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret/staging/encryption/DEK-abc123. Justification: decrypt sample payloads to confirm whether key rotation caused the failure. End time: 30m from grant.
security: Quick checklist before granting: 1) redact any plaintext keys from logs, 2) session must be recorded, 3) no copying secrets to persistent storage. Approving conditionally — @emma needs to sign off.
emma: I can approve for 30m. Please leave steps you'll take in the ticket and confirm you won't paste secret values in chat.
ops-liaison: Will create a temporary role with scoped SecretsManager:GetSecretValue for that ARN only. I'll run: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/debug-secrets-read --duration-seconds 1800` and post the session link here when ready.
oncall-bot: Break-glass request logged (INC-4821). Approval by emma recorded. Awaiting ops-liaison action.
ops-liaison: Done — granted `debug/secrets-read` session to maya for 1800s. Session console link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/console/home?roleSession=debug-xyz (expires in 30m). Audit id: audit-0x9f7.
maya: Got it, thanks. Will run the repro, collect logs, and avoid pasting secrets. I'll update INC-4821 with steps and findings.
security: Reminder: if you capture any secret material in logs, mark the log entries for redaction and ping us. If you need to share sanitized snippets, use the redact tool or pastebin with TTL. :lock:
maya: ACK. Will scrub outputs and report back in ~25m.
emma: Thanks everyone. Please close the loop in INC-4821 when done.
